name: Journalism
overview: Journalism is a critical and dynamic field that informs, educates, and engages the public to make a significant contribution to society. The profession has evolved from printed newspapers to encompass digital platforms, television, radio, and podcasts. Modern journalism requires storytelling abilities combined with investigative rigor and adaptability to changing technologies and media landscapes.

topJobs.description: Gathering information and crafting news stories for various media platforms
Reviewing and approving articles; ensuring accuracy and quality of content
Using photography to capture and convey the essence of news stories
Presenting news on radio and television as anchors, correspondents, or producers
